[SWS_CM_10330] Transport protocol for sending of a SOME/IP request message
⌈
The SOME/IP request message for the Set method shall be transmitted using the
transport protocol defined by the attribute SomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment.
fieldDeployment.set.transportProtocol in the Manifest.
The SOME/IP re-
quest message for the Get method shall be transmitted using the transport protocol de-
fined by the attribute SomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment.fieldDeployment.
get.transportProtocol respectively.
